rationale: The reviewer found that 70 of 100 test promoters are near-copies of training promoters, with accuracy 1.00 on those versus 0.50 on the 30 unrelated ones. A 4-mer model at chance showed the labels carry no sequence signal. They proposed an MMseqs2/CD-HIT cluster split with accuracy reported by distance to training. Their other points (baselines, single seed, small n, overreach) are generic or follow from the leakage mechanism, so none is a separate important issue.
